rows.jp: 扉を押し開ける。
rows.en: I pushed the door open.

ghs.en: I push the door open.

rows.jp: 抵抗があった。
rows.en: Something resisted.

ghs.en: There was opposition,

rows.jp: 向こう側から押さえられている。
rows.en: It was being held shut from the other side.

ghs.en: a push back from the opposite side.

rows.jp: 強く押す。
rows.en: I shoved harder.

ghs.en: I push with strength.

rows.jp: 扉の向こうで、小さな乱気流が霧散した。
rows.en: A tiny pocket of turbulence dissipated beyond the door.

ghs.en: On the other side of the door, a tiny bit of foggy turbolence dispersed.

rows.jp: 風だったのだ。
rows.en: Just the wind.

ghs.en: It was the wind.

rows.jp: アンテナ。
rows.en: The antenna.

ghs.en: An antenna.

rows.jp: それなりに形になっている。
rows.en: It was taking shape.

ghs.en: That's what it's acquiring the shape of.

rows.jp: 指向性や波長など、いろいろな調整が必要だ。
rows.en: Directionality, wavelength—there were all sorts of adjustments to make.

ghs.en: Directionality and wavelength and more, all sorts of tuning is required.

rows.jp: が、そういう知識は俺にはない。
rows.en: None of which I knew the first thing about.

ghs.en: However, I am not an expert on any of those things.

rows.jp: 先輩も詳しくはなかったが、勉強したらしい。
rows.en: She hadn't known much herself, but apparently she'd studied up.

ghs.en: Senpai also wasn't particularly well-informed, but she seemed to be studying diligently.

rows.jp: その先輩だが……いない。
rows.en: And Mimi herself... was nowhere to be seen.

ghs.en: And that Senpai... is not here.

rows.jp: 工具。
rows.en: Tools.

ghs.en: Tools,

rows.jp: 脚立。
rows.en: A stepladder.

ghs.en: stepladder,

rows.jp: 書物。
rows.en: Books.

ghs.en: books,

rows.jp: 風で飛び散った、菓子パンの空袋。
rows.en: An empty wrapper from a sweet bun, blown loose by the wind.

ghs.en: empty packets of sweet bread, scattered around by the wind.

rows.jp: 作業をしていた痕跡だけが残されている。
rows.en: Only the traces of her work remained.

ghs.en: All that is left behind are the vestiges of fatigue work.

rows.jp: ２４時間作業しているわけでもないのか。
rows.en: Apparently she didn't work around the clock after all.

ghs.en: She hasn't even worked for 24 hours after all.

rows.jp: アンテナを見あげた。
rows.en: I looked up at the antenna.

ghs.en: I look up at the antenna.

rows.jp: 周囲が開けていて、背の高い建物。
rows.en: Open space. A tall building.

ghs.en: The surroundings are open, the building is tall.

rows.jp: 電波を飛ばすには、うってつけの環境らしい。
rows.en: Apparently ideal for sending out radio waves.

ghs.en: This seems an ideal environment to make electromagnetic waves fly out.

rows.jp: コミュニティＦＭという、地域密着型のラジオ放送がある。
rows.en: There was a kind of hyperlocal broadcasting known as community FM.

ghs.en: A Community FM, to clarify, is a local-based radio broadcast.

rows.jp: 本来、学校の部活でやるほど敷居の低いものでもない。
rows.en: Normally, the barrier to entry was far too high for a school club.

ghs.en: By nature, this is not something at the low threshold of the accomplishments achievable in a school club.

rows.jp: が。
rows.en: But—

ghs.en: But.

rows.jp: 立地と、群青学院のなりたちと、地元有志の善意溢れる意向。
rows.en: the location, Gunjo Academy's history, the boundless goodwill of certain local volunteers...

ghs.en: The location, the purpose of Gunjou Institute, the ideas of local volunteers overflowing with good intentions:

rows.jp: そういったものが、今回の話に結びついた。
rows.en: had all come together to make this possible.

ghs.en: all those things join together into this here.

rows.jp: 準備が進められていたが、とあるやむを得ない事件によって、うやむやになっていた。
rows.en: Preparations had been underway, until an unavoidable incident left the whole thing in limbo.

ghs.en: The assembly was proceeding, but, because of a certain inevitable incident, it was all left incomplete.

rows.jp: 搬入されたアンテナは、一年、そのまま放置されることになった。
rows.en: The antenna was delivered, then abandoned as it stood for a full year.

ghs.en: This antenna had been brought in and, for a year, left in this condition.

rows.jp: そんな事情があるのだった。
rows.en: That was how things had ended up.

ghs.en: Those were the circumstances and the reasons for this.

rows.jp: おそらくＦＭ群青に求められていたものは、健気に生きる少年少女たちの希望に満ちた愛コンテンツ、だったのだろうけど。
rows.en: Presumably Gunjo Community FM Station was expected to serve up hope-filled, heartwarming content about plucky boys and girls.

ghs.en: Perhaps the item boldly demanded of the Gunjou FM had, as contents, a love filled with the aspirations of brave boys and girls, but,

rows.jp: ごめん、そんなものは群青にはありません。
rows.en: Sorry. Gunjo didn't have any of that.

ghs.en: sorry, that's something that doesn't exist in Gunjou.

rows.jp: 結果オーライだと言える。
rows.en: Which had worked out for the best.

ghs.en: It could be said it turned out awright in the end.

rows.jp: 見里先輩は、ＳＯＳ計画を立てた。
rows.en: Misato had come up with the SOS plan.

ghs.en: Misato-senpai started her SOS Project.

rows.jp: 日曜の夜に彼女はそう言った。
rows.en: She'd proposed it Sunday night.

ghs.en: She said she would on the night of Sunday,

rows.jp: 人類が消失してしまったことを、手分けして確認してからだ。
rows.en: After we'd split up to confirm that humanity really had disappeared.

ghs.en: after we had split up and verified that mankind had completely vanished.

rows.jp: 高所にアンテナがあるのだから、完成させて発信してみようという試みは……いかにも現実味が乏しい。
rows.en: Given the antenna hardware on the roof, finishing it and trying a transmission... wasn’t exactly a realistic plan.

ghs.en: Because of the heights involved in the antenna, trying to complete it and attempting to send out a transmission... are actions that manifest an exceedingly scarce sense for the materially possible.

rows.jp: 正直、先輩はほつれてしまった、と思った。
rows.en: Honestly, I thought Mimi had begun to unravel.

ghs.en: Honestly, I thought Senpai had just become frayed.

rows.jp: 逃避は次第に人を弱くする。
rows.en: The longer you ran away, the weaker you became.

ghs.en: Flight gradually makes a person weak.

rows.jp: そして先輩はもともと十分に弱かった。
rows.en: And Mimi had been fragile enough to begin with.

ghs.en: And Senpai was more than weak enough from the start.

rows.jp: 「ぺけくん？」
rows.en: “Peke?”

ghs.en: Misato: "Peke-kun?"

rows.jp: 背後。
rows.en: Behind me.

ghs.en: From behind.

rows.jp: 向き直る。
rows.en: I turned.

ghs.en: I turn around.

rows.jp: 「はろーです。先輩」
rows.en: “Hello there, Mimi.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hullo, Senpai."

rows.jp: 「はろーです……えーと、どうしました？」
rows.en: “Hello there... Um, what brings you here?”

ghs.en: Misato: "Hullo then... uhm, what do you need?"

rows.jp: 「様子を見に来ました」
rows.en: “I came to see how you were doing.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I came to see how things are."

rows.jp: 先輩はふんにゃりと微笑む。
rows.en: Mimi’s face melted into a soft smile.

ghs.en: Senpai makes a fluffy and enervated smile.

rows.jp: 「そうでしたか」
rows.en: “I see.”

ghs.en: Misato: "So you did."

rows.jp: 「しばらく来てなかったんですけど、だいぶできてますね」
rows.en: “I haven’t been up here in a while. You’ve made a lot of progress.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I did not come in for a while, but still this is some considerable progress."

rows.jp: 「けっこう前からコツコツとやってますから」
rows.en: “I’ve been chipping away at it for quite some time.”

ghs.en: Misato: "I have been doing things like this steadily and diligently for quite a while."

rows.jp: そう。
rows.en: Right.

ghs.en: True.

rows.jp: 放送部が自然崩壊してからこっち。
rows.en: Ever since the Broadcasting Club had quietly collapsed.

ghs.en: Since the natural downfall of the Broadcast Club to now,

rows.jp: 先輩は一人ですべてをこなしていた。
rows.en: Mimi had done everything alone.

ghs.en: Senpai has been doing everything all alone.

rows.jp: 昼休みのＤＪ。
rows.en: The lunchtime DJ slot.

ghs.en: Manning the intrascholastic radio on lunch break,

rows.jp: 各種放送。
rows.en: Every other broadcast.

ghs.en: with broadcasts of all sorts.

rows.jp: すべて。
rows.en: Everything.

ghs.en: Everything.

rows.jp: 誰も手伝わなくなった。
rows.en: No one helped anymore.

ghs.en: There was no longer any help from anyone.

rows.jp: 霧は俺を敵視するようになり、
rows.en: Kiri had begun treating me as an enemy.

ghs.en: Kiri came to see me as an enemy,

rows.jp: 友貴は姉を避けるようになり、
rows.en: Tomoki had begun avoiding his sister.

ghs.en: Tomoki came to avoid his sister,

rows.jp: 美希はおろおろと苦笑い、
rows.en: Miki could only hover nearby with an anxious smile.

ghs.en: Miki made forced nervous smiles,

rows.jp: 冬子も俺を無視しはじめ、
rows.en: Touko had begun ignoring me too.

ghs.en: Touko also began to ignore me.

rows.jp: 見事、瓦解。
rows.en: Spectacular collapse.

ghs.en: A collapse, a magnificent one.

rows.jp: 桜庭だけがいつもと変わりなかった。
rows.en: Only Sakuraba remained exactly the same.

ghs.en: Sakuraba alone never changed from his always.

rows.jp: 変わりなく、サボっていた。
rows.en: He went right on skipping out.

ghs.en: And, unchangingly, he cut club.

rows.jp: 俺はそれでも先輩の周囲をうろちょろしていたけど。
rows.en: I kept hovering around Mimi anyway.

ghs.en: I nevertheless hung around Senpai, but,

rows.jp: 彼女の方が、手伝いを拒んだ。
rows.en: She was the one who refused my help.

ghs.en: it was her who refused assistance.

rows.jp: 「……そうでしたね」
rows.en: “...That’s right.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...so you did."

rows.jp: 「びっくりしましたねぇ、それにしても」
rows.en: “Still, it was quite a shock, wasn’t it?”

ghs.en: Misato: "This was surprising, all things considered."

rows.jp: 「ですなー」
rows.en: “Sure was.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Really now."

rows.jp: 「人が一斉にいなくなるなんて」
rows.en: “Everyone disappearing all at once...”

ghs.en: Misato: "People vanished, and all at once."

rows.jp: 「静かですよね」
rows.en: “It’s quiet.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "So quiet, is it not?"

rows.jp: 「すごくすごく静かです」
rows.en: “So very, very quiet.”

ghs.en: Misato: "Very but very quiet it is."

rows.jp: 「どこ行ってたんです？」
rows.en: “Where were you?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Where did you just go?"

rows.jp: 「ちょっと……おなかがすいたので」
rows.en: “I was... a little hungry.”

ghs.en: Misato: "Well... I was a bit hungry, so."

rows.jp: 「昼ですしね。うまく食料見つけられました？」
rows.en: “It’s lunchtime. Find anything to eat?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "This is noon. Were you able to find food without problems?"

rows.jp: 「ああ、家に戻ってました。食べ物は特に不自由してないですし」
rows.en: “Oh, I went home. I’ve got plenty of food there.”

ghs.en: Misato: "Ahhh, I had to go back home. I have no particular shortage of food."

rows.jp: 「あー、学校サボリー。部長がさぼりー」
rows.en: “Ooh, playing hooky! The club president is playing hooky!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Aaah, you cut schooool. Prez is a cutteeer!"

rows.jp: 「ち、違いますよっ、これはさぼりではありませんっ」
rows.en: “N-no! This isn’t playing hooky!”

ghs.en: Misato: "N-, not true!, this is not cutting at all!"

rows.jp: 焦る。
rows.en: Panic.

ghs.en: Flustered,

rows.jp: 規則重視の人なのだ。
rows.en: She was a stickler for rules.

ghs.en: because she is a person that stresses regulations.

rows.jp: 「停学、停学です」
rows.en: “Suspension! That’s a suspension!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Suspension, there will be a suspension!"

rows.jp: 「停学はいやー、履歴に傷がー」
rows.en: “Nooo, not suspension! It’ll go on my permanent record!”

ghs.en: Misato: "Suspension is baaad, it will stain my recooord!"

rows.jp: 「停学！　停学！」
rows.en: “Suspension! Suspension!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Suspension! Suspension!"

rows.jp: 「停学はだめですー」
rows.en: “I can’t be suspended!”

ghs.en: Misato: "Suspension is unacceptableee!"

rows.jp: 二人ではしゃいでいた。
rows.en: We horsed around together.

ghs.en: We made merry with the two of us.

rows.jp: これが今の俺たちの、最短距離だった。
rows.en: That was as close as the two of us could come now.

ghs.en: That was the shortest of distances for us as we are now.
